The PR head is still `8817cba`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Gate verdicts on the head.** 31 check-runs `success`, 3 `skipped` (dependabot, the coverage shards), 1 `failure`: **Spec Main Shape Gate**. Its annotations name `packages/react/src/hooks/useViewData.ts` (124–125, TS2367) and `packages/core/src/adapters/resolveDataSource.ts` (59–62, TS2678/TS2339), each "compiled against @objectstack/spec built from objectstack-ai/objectstack@b5b1bf7" — a `dataSource` kind union on objectstack `main` that no longer carries `"api"`. Neither file is in this PR's file list, and nothing in the diff touches `dataSource` kinds; the failure is pre-existing drift between objectui `main` and the unreleased spec `main`, not this head's. The 12 test shards, the dist pins, Type Check, Lint, Repo Gates, Build Docs, Build & E2E and the four changeset gates all pass, which answers the dev's declared narrowing (full-package suites of plugin-form / plugin-detail / components / app-shell NOT MEASURED locally; `check:doc-examples` / `check:doc-snippets` / `check:readme-exports` stopped at a build precondition).

**Public-surface changes the diff implies, package by package:**

- `@object-ui/react` — **widens, right.** `packages/react/src/context/index.ts` gains `export * from './PrintPageContext.js'`, and the entry barrel re-exports `./context/index.js`, so `PrintPageContext`, `PrintPageProvider` and `usePrintPage` are new public exports under the package's only export `.`. The value type is `PagePrint` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, which the package already depends on (`^18.0.0-next.0`), so no phantom dependency. `usePrintPage()` is safe outside a provider (`null` default). Claim `Clause-②: yes` is the right declaration.
- `@object-ui/types` — **does not widen, right.** The diff under `packages/types/src` is the `ExportFormat` doc comment only. `print` on `PageNodeSchema` rides the spec `Page` by reference (the `Omit` over `PAGE_SPEC_EXCLUDED` from objectui#12030), which is what `page-print.ts` reads as `NonNullable of PageNodeSchema['print']`. No mirror was needed and none was added.
- `@object-ui/components` — **public surface unchanged, right.** `renderers/layout/page-print.ts` is new and exports `buildPagePrintStylesheet`, `isPagePrintDeclaration`, `PRINT_PAGE_ATTRIBUTE`, `PRINT_RUNNING_ATTRIBUTE` and the `PagePrintDeclaration` type, but the entry barrel exports `./ui`, `./custom`, `./notifications`, `./debug`, `./share` and named symbols only; `renderers/layout/index.ts` side-effect-imports `./page` and `page.tsx` only imports from `./page-print` without re-exporting. The test file reaches the module by relative path. So the package publishes a behaviour change (the registered `PageRenderer` now stamps `data-print-page`, mounts a `style[data-print-stylesheet]` and wraps the page in `PrintPageProvider` when `schema.print` is an object) and no new symbol.
- `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` — **behaviour only, no new exports, right.** `LineItemsPanel`, `DetailSection` and `RecordDetailView` change internally; the barrels are untouched. app-shell's `RecordDetailView` adds a `Button` with `data-testid="record-print-button"` only when the rendered page's `print` is a non-array object.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-report` — **comment-only, right.** Two comments in `ListView.tsx`, one in `ReportViewer.tsx`; no runtime text and no export moves.

**Accept-set changes the diff implies:** none on the authoring side. The renderer reads `print` as "any non-array object" (`isPagePrintDeclaration`) and clamps values at the stylesheet boundary (enum members for `paperSize` / `orientation`, finite non-negative numbers for margins, exact `true` for the booleans); every other value falls back to the spec default. That is an injection boundary below the spec's parse-time refusal, not a second contract, and the pin for it is in `page-print-stylesheet-11958.test.tsx`. On the wire, `record:line_items` on a print page asks for `$top: cap + 1` and `$count: true` and slices the probe row off before drawing — the same construction `applyNonGridRowCeiling` already uses in core, so no new query shape reaches an adapter.

**"The page renders on screen exactly as before" (card item 1), judged on the diff:**

- A page that does NOT declare `print`: `PageRenderer` computes `print = null`, mounts no style element, no attribute, no provider, and returns `pageContent` as before. `RunningRegions` returns a plain fragment of `header`, body, `footer` when neither `repeatHeader` nor `repeatFooter` is true, so each of the four templates (`RegionLayout`, `HeaderSidebarMainTemplate`, `ThreeColumnTemplate`, `DashboardTemplate`) renders the same flex children in the same order as the pre-diff markup (I compared the removed and added JSX of each: header, body wrapper, footer; `HeaderSidebarMainTemplate` had no footer before and passes none now). `DetailSection`'s `isCollapsed` is `collapsedState` when `usePrintPage()` is `null`. `LineItemsPanel`'s read is `$top: top` with no `$count`, and `rowCap` stays `null`; `printing` is in the load dependency list but is constant for a page, so it triggers no extra read. `RecordDetailView` draws no button. **Right — unchanged.** The components pin "a print page without running regions is DOM-identical to the plain page apart from the attribute and the style element" is the right control, and the app-shell / plugin-form / plugin-detail pins each carry a no-`print` control.
- A page that declares `print` with `repeatHeader` / `repeatFooter`: the DOM gains a `table[data-print-running]` whose table, section, row and cell boxes carry `class="contents"` and `role="presentation"`, so the regions stay the flex column's children on screen (the dev's Chromium bounding-box measurement says identical boxes; the pin checks every box has `contents`). This is the one screen-side DOM change, confined to print pages that opt into running regions, and it is the price of a real `thead` / `tfoot`, which the dev measured as the only construct Chromium repeats. Accepted as within the card's "print only adds the print stylesheet" reading: nothing visible moves.
- Every emitted rule is inside `@media print {` (pinned as the first and last text of the sheet). The global hide rule (`body :not(:has(page)):not(page):not(page *) { display: none }`) and the ancestor-release rule only exist on a document that renders a print page, and only on paper.

**Card items 2–4.** (2) The printable subset is read from `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` in `@objectstack/spec/ui` by `printable-blocks-registered-11958.test.ts` with no second list in the repo; the known gap from card ①'s review (`record:line_items` silent cap) is closed by the visible `NonGridRowCeilingNote` naming the cap and, when reported, the total; a collapsed `record:details` section draws open. (3) The Print action calls `window.print()` from the record view and is offered only where the bound page declares `print`. (4) The "declined NOT_PLANNED" sentence is rewritten at all four measured sites (`types/src/objectql.ts`, `ListView.tsx` twice, `ReportViewer.tsx`, app-shell `styles.css`) and the fifth the dev found (`DashboardView.tsx`); the ListView menu-format reasoning and the ReportViewer button semantics are unchanged in behaviour.

### ② Semver level

The changeset `.changeset/11958-print-page-render.md` declares `minor` for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `patch` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-report`. Judged against what the diff publishes per package (① above): react adds three exports — minor, right; components / plugin-form / plugin-detail / app-shell add a feature with no symbol change and no removed behaviour — minor, right; types / plugin-list / plugin-report are comment-only — patch, right. No major: nothing is removed or renamed, and a page without `print` is byte-identical. The changeset body names the new react exports by name. Changeset Declaration, Bump Policy, Claim Re-read, Fixed Group Check and Overwrite Report are all `success` on this head.

`Clause-②: yes` on the claim and in the PR body matches the measured widening of `@object-ui/react`. The `--pair` exit code the dispatch asked for is retired (ruling `5770886272` on objectstack#19061, per `clause2-line.mjs`); the dev's "NOT MEASURED" for it is the right spelling.

The unidentified stalling file is noted by the dev as unreproduced, not a filing class; nothing in this diff changes test infrastructure. Accepted.

- **Harness PR footer replaced by the role file's session-URL footer.** A reporting-form deviation with no effect on the diff. Noted.
- **Open question 1 — binding a SEPARATE print page to a record.** Answered **A** for this head: the ruling's M1 clause is "a 'print' action on the record page that opens the browser's print preview of the bound page", and the only binding the spec and `usePageAssignment` know is the record page assigned to the object; no spec key names a second page, so B would be a spec contract-door card in objectstack, and C would be an undeclared selection rule.
